org.openpe.emc-flyback-example.attribution: Chengmin Li and AI-PCB-layout contributors; KiCad library contributors
org.openpe.emc-flyback-example.changes: Native KiCad 7 board normalized to supported KiCad 10 records. Footprints are repositioned to clear courtyard overlaps and align local pad connections. Tracks use horizontal, vertical and 45-degree paths. Redundant local segments are removed and zones are refilled. Original nets, pad shapes, vias and retained track identities and locks are preserved. Passive Values retain only the nominal value; rating, dielectric, package and series text is preserved in Specifications fields. Instance Reference/Value text is arranged for legibility. Five power flags declare existing rails and the project symbol library carries the embedded LED, TL431DBZ and LTV-817S drawings. Four editable OpenPE CAD panels replace the MECH1/MECH2 enclosure placeholders, which are omitted from PCB footprints and project footprint libraries. Original source files and static enclosure assets are pinned separately. Behavioural transient model and board-only thermal analysis are bounded approximations.

files.name: emc-flyback.kicad_dru
files.source:
(version 1)
# EMC demo flyback rev E -- voltage-based clearance (= creepage on the flat board surface) rules.
# Net-class clearances (kicad_pro): P_HV 0.6 mm (31-100 V), P_PWR/P_HI/CHASSIS/S_HI 0.4 mm (<= 34 V), signals 0.2 mm.
(rule "low-voltage primary pairs (<= 13 V apart)"
  (condition "(A.NetClass == 'P_HI' || A.NetClass == 'P_SIG') && B.NetClass == 'P_SIG'")
  (constraint clearance (min 0.2mm)))
(rule "primary-secondary isolation"
  (condition "(A.NetClass == 'P_HV' || A.NetClass == 'P_PWR' || A.NetClass == 'P_HI' || A.NetClass == 'P_SIG') && (B.NetClass == 'S_HI' || B.NetClass == 'S_SIG')")
  (constraint clearance (min 2.5mm)))
(rule "chassis-secondary"
  (condition "A.NetClass == 'CHASSIS' && (B.NetClass == 'S_HI' || B.NetClass == 'S_SIG')")
  (constraint clearance (min 1.5mm)))
(rule "YPS jumper pins (intended bridge)"
  (condition "A.Type != 'Zone' && B.Type != 'Zone' && A.intersectsCourtyard('YPS') && B.intersectsCourtyard('YPS')")
  (constraint clearance (min 0.5mm)))
(rule "SGCH jumper pins (intended bridge)"
  (condition "A.Type != 'Zone' && B.Type != 'Zone' && A.intersectsCourtyard('SGCH') && B.intersectsCourtyard('SGCH')")
  (constraint clearance (min 0.5mm)))
(rule "CASE jumper pins (intended bridge)"
  (condition "A.Type != 'Zone' && B.Type != 'Zone' && A.intersectsCourtyard('CASE') && B.intersectsCourtyard('CASE')")
  (constraint clearance (min 0.5mm)))
(rule "U2 package pin pitch"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && B.Type == 'Pad' && A.intersectsCourtyard('U2') && B.intersectsCourtyard('U2')")
  (constraint clearance (min 0.3mm)))
